description: Fetch the full verified record for one NABarFinder venue by its stable slug: city, neighborhood, address and coordinates (when it has a fixed location), venue type, naProgramStrength (1–5), full description, NA brands stocked (brandSlugs), last-verified date, canonical nabarfinder.com URL, and — when the registry has them — website, phone, hours, signature drinks, and a sourced press quote. Fields absent from the registry are omitted, never invented. Read-only.

slug.description: The venue's stable slug id, e.g. 'sans-bar-austin' — as returned by search_venues or the /api/v1/venues.json feed.

name: get_venue
